dispositions.title: platform functional audit
dispositions.rationale: Use audit findings as discovery input; do not merge because Phase 2 starts from a new authoritative contract.

dispositions.title: customer PWA functional audit
dispositions.rationale: Preserve customer visibility and privacy observations as requirements evidence.

dispositions.title: interest selection scheduling
dispositions.rationale: Interest selection belongs in Phase 2 staffing semantics, but implementation must be rebuilt against the canonical lifecycle.

dispositions.title: backoffice functional audit
dispositions.rationale: Backoffice findings inform planboard and status contracts without carrying forward runtime changes.

dispositions.title: credential challenge protocol
dispositions.rationale: Account recovery protocol evidence is in Phase 2 scope; port compatible docs/tests after contract approval.

dispositions.title: personnel PWA functional audit
dispositions.rationale: Use personnel workflow findings to shape execution/offline acceptance.

dispositions.title: assignment P0 reproduction
dispositions.rationale: P0 reproduction should become deterministic acceptance coverage for generic overrides and zero-row updates.

dispositions.title: availability atomicity
dispositions.rationale: Atomic availability semantics are required, but runtime code must wait for Phase 2 implementation workstreams.

dispositions.title: finance/worker audit
dispositions.rationale: Finance observations matter downstream, but Phase 2 only defines assignment-to-invoice visibility boundaries.

dispositions.title: team execution architecture
dispositions.rationale: Multi-person execution is core Phase 2 scope and must be reimplemented under the participant aggregation contract.
